packages.reason: The central teaching of Torah #205 is that the word תהלים (gematria תפ"ה) equals the two divine names אל אלקים spelled out — and those names are a bechina of חסד וגבורה. The lost seed (טפה) itself is also a bechina of חסד וגבורה (it contains the forces of fire and water, warmth and moisture). The seed originates from דעת, which is equally a bechina of חסד וגבורה. And דעת is further specified as חמשה חסדים וחמש גבורות — ten elements — which is why ten chapters must be recited. The isolated pair עשרה מיני זמרה / עשרה לשונות is merged here because 'ten' is the structural key that connects them: the 10 types of song = the 10 languages of Psalms, and the reason there are 10 chapters is precisely that דעת = 5+5 = ten. They share the same essential domain of the complete ten-structure of da'at expressed as chesed and gevurah. חסד וגבורה is the dominant hub (4 direct bechina connections); דעת is secondary (2 direct connections). All nodes in this package describe the same cosmic duality that both defines the problem (the fallen seed is chesed-gevurah captured by the klipa) and defines the solution (תהלים = אל אלקים = chesed-gevurah that can extract the seed from the klipa).

merge_notes.reason: This isolated pair is a bechina-pair (edge 2460): the 10 types of song are the 10 languages of the book of Psalms. Their connection to Package 1 is through the number ten: the Rebbe explicitly explains that one recites ten chapters because דעת = חמשה חסדים וחמש גבורות (ten elements). The 10 songs/languages are the practical expression of that same ten-structure. Their essential nature — the completeness of ten as the structure of da'at — places them within the same thematic family as חמשה חסדים וחמש גבורות, חסד וגבורה, and דעת. An eitza flow connects this pair to the Package 1 hub (the reason for ten chapters flows from דעת = ten), making their package membership unambiguous.
